name: pmg-write-user-stories
description: Writes a User Story Set from a PRD section or a story map slice, with Given / When / Then acceptance criteria, an INVEST check per story and questions for refinement. Use for "run pmg-write-user-stories", "write user stories", "acceptance criteria", "Given When Then", "INVEST check", "engineers say the requirements are not detailed enough", "prepare for backlog refinement", "turn this slice into stories", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
